failure_criteria: Any hard gate violation invalidates the run.
Missing/duplicate outcomes or altered frozen inputs invalidate comparison.
No PROGRESS verdict on public/exposed cases, ever.
No superiority claim from abstention alone, from matching a shortcut control, or from draft labels.
Any held-out answer exposure invalidates blind use for subsequent tuning.
Retention and misleading conditions both required; no composite substitution.
Missing comparators, adjudicated gold, holdout, or citation evidence yields INCONCLUSIVE.
amendments: Append a new version and amendment rationale; never overwrite v1/v1.5 evidence.
